note: Fuzzer-controlled bytes are copied into the HPACK decode buffer and drive the parser path.
The decoder must reject header indexes that are not valid for the current dynamic table state; this safety check is the key obligation.
This predicate carries the table-size-dependent validity relation used by the decoder.
An accepted index is dereferenced to fetch a header value from the dynamic table; if the validity relation is violated, this becomes an invalid memory access.
